summary.answer: Builds a spawn-beacon radius/icon/label/pulse/name. Name states map exact gamemodeFlags 0..4 to threat/EMP/manual labels plus the inactive-beacon predicate. Parent Destroyed uses the disabled-or-destroyed helper and Hidden calls AlwaysFalse. It does not activate or spawn a beacon. Creates self via LUI.UIElement.new, SpawnSelectRadius via CoD.SpawnRegionRadius.new, SpawnSelectIconBg via CoD.SpawnSelectLocationMarker.new, SpawnSelectLabel via CoD.SpawnSelectionLabel.new, SpawnSelectPulse via CoD.SpawnRegionPulse.new, SpawnBeaconPoint via CoD.SpawnRegionName.new. Stores state predicates Destroyed, ThreatLow, ThreatMedium, ThreatHigh, DisabledEMP, ManualDisabled, Destroyed, Hidden; their body effects require state-system evaluation.
